purpose: Canonical route layer for accessories obtained through Online Raid Quests, Crystal Raid Battles, mentor or character gifts, and ranked/event routes. Routes are kept separate from canonical identity and are not treated as interchangeable unless supported.

verification_policy.indexed: Accessory or route discovered, but meaningful current acquisition details remain unresolved.
verification_policy.partially_verified: Identity and route family are supported, but current availability, exact reward threshold, or alternate-route behavior remains unresolved.
verification_policy.verified: Identity, route, relevant reward condition, and applicable alternate routes are reconciled against sufficient evidence.

research_rules: Raid history is not the same thing as current availability.
Crystal Raid Battle and Online Raid Quest are separate systems even when they expose the same accessory.
Mentor gifts are separate acquisition routes and must not create duplicate canonical accessories.
Clothing sets are not accessories; component names must be reconciled individually.
Exact reward thresholds are only recorded when directly supported and should not be inferred from another raid's structure.
